## Conventions
- **Base path:** every backend endpoint is under `API_PREFIX` = `/api`, except `GET /health` and the static `/uploads/*`. Routers without a prefix declare full paths (for example `/workflows/...`). There is no versioning in the path.
- **Auth:**
  - session cookies (`mdat_session` for users, `mdat_admin` for admins), not headers;
  - every route needs a matching rule in `auth/permissions.RULES`, or it is denied with 403;
  - the "Auth / role" column below uses the permission keys and these access levels:
    - PUBLIC: no session;
    - ANY: any signed-in user or admin;
    - USER: any signed-in user;
    - SELF: the caller's own session;
    - ADMIN: a platform admin.
- **Error body:**
  - FastAPI's `{"detail": "<message>"}`, or `{"detail": [...]}` for 422 validation;
  - auth errors are `{"detail", "code"}` with the status from `AuthError`;
  - a workspace with no usable Mistral key gives 409 `{"detail", "code": "workspace_key"}`;
  - Tool Service unavailability is surfaced as 503 with a plain message.
- **Pagination:**
  - most local lists are unpaginated;
  - Mistral-backed lists accept `page` and `page_size`, or a cursor (agents are listed by cursor);
  - audit and logs accept `limit`, `before` and filters.
- **Streaming:** `text/event-stream` with `id:`, `event:` and `data:` lines (runs, ops, executions, RAG timelines, chat stream).
- **Request progress:** the optional `X-Op-Id` header on any request publishes progress at `/ops/{id}/events`.
- **The Tool Service** has no prefix and no auth. Its OpenAPI is at `:9000/docs`; the backend's is at `:8000/docs`. The root `openapi.yaml` is stale; regenerate it from `/openapi.json` if needed.

## Endpoints
Grouped by router. Per-endpoint request and response fields are in each router's per-file doc (`replication/files/backend/app/routes/*.md`); this table records the contract shape and the access rule.

| Method | Path | Auth / role | Request | Response | Side effects | Served by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/health` | PUBLIC | none | `{status:"healthy", service, version:"2.0.0", docker_tool_service: reachable/unreachable}` | none | `main.py` |
| GET | `/api/status` | ANY | none | Whether the platform is up, as the caller sees it in their workspace (component verdicts for the Health page) | Probes the components | `routes/status.py` |
| GET | `/api/ops/{op_id}/events` | ANY | none | SSE progress | none | `routes/progress.py` |
| GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE | `/api/auth/session`, `/policy`, `/check`, `/login`, `/logout`, `/logout-all`, `/workspace`, `/password`, `/profile`, `/sessions(/{id})`, `/links/{token}` | SELF (login and links are public in practice) | `{email, password}`, `{workspace_id}`, `{current, new}`, `{name}` | Session `{user, workspaces, active_workspace, permissions}`; the policy rules | Sets and clears the cookie, sessions, audit | `routes/auth.py` |
| POST | `/api/admin/auth/login` | PUBLIC | `{email, password}` | Admin session | Admin cookie | `routes/admin.py` |
| * | `/api/admin/*` (auth, overview, permissions, workspaces (+ check-key, check, rotate-key, members), users (+ memberships, link, disable, enable, unlock, sessions/revoke), roles, admins (+ link), health, audit, logs) | ADMIN | JSON bodies per resource | Resource JSON; links contain one-time tokens | Writes `auth_*` and the audit; starts or stops workers | `routes/admin.py` |
| GET, PUT, POST | `/api/settings`, `/settings/reset`, `/settings/models/catalog`, `/models/refresh`, `/models/review`, `/settings/public` | GET: settings.view (admin ok). Catalog: ANY. Writes: ADMIN | PUT `{backend:{key: value}, tool_service:{key: value}}`; reset `{target?, section?, keys?}` | Sections, settings and effective values | Writes `runtime_settings.json`, runs the hooks (for example retargeting the Tool Service) and proxies Tool Service settings | `routes/settings.py` |

## Outbound APIs
| Provider | Endpoint / SDK call | Purpose | Model / version | Timeout / retries |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mistral | `client.chat.complete` / `complete_async` via `core.decision.decide` | Every decision layer | Per role: `mistral-medium-2604`, falling back to `mistral-large-4` (`llm_routes.py`); `MISTRAL_ORCHESTRATOR_MODEL` with `ORCHESTRATOR_REASONING_EFFORT` high | Route timeouts of 90–240 s; hedge after 45 s; up to 4 rate-limit retries with jittered backoff from 2 s |
| Mistral | `client.beta.agents.*` | Create, update, list (cursor) and delete agents | Agent models: `DEFAULT_AGENT_MODEL` mistral-medium-latest; choices `AGENT_MODEL_CHOICES` | SDK defaults, offloaded to threads |
| Mistral | `client.beta.conversations.start/append(_stream)` | Agent chat, agent steps, evaluation | The agent's model; hedge to `AGENT_FALLBACK_MODEL` after 40 s | `AGENT_CALL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` 180 |
| Mistral | `client.beta.libraries.*` and documents | Libraries, document inputs, RAG ingestion | none | Text polling every 5 s, 60 attempts |
| Mistral | Connectors REST | Directory and custom MCP connectors, credentials, activation | none | httpx |
| Mistral | Workflows SDK (`mistralai.workflows`) | Register, archive and execute workflows; signals, queries and updates; traces | none | Registration wait 30 s |
| Mistral | `client.ocr.process` | PDF and image text for knowledge sources and attachments | `mistral-ocr-latest` | none |
| Mistral | Audio transcriptions | Audio for models that cannot listen | `voxtral-mini-latest` | none |
| Mistral | `client.embeddings` | Knowledge item embeddings | `mistral-embed` | none |
| Mistral | `GET /v1/models` | The model catalog | none | Every 24 h |
| Mistral | OTLP traces (`MISTRAL_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` or `OBSERVABILITY_ENDPOINT`), observability read API | Tracing actions, runs and executions; the Logs pages | none | Batch export; flush on shutdown |
| Mistral | `chat.complete` from the Tool Service (`app/llm`) | Synthesis roles (spec, author, repair, oracle, test plan) | Role routes; Codestral is excluded from code roles; `MISTRAL_CODING_MODEL` optional | `TOOL_MODEL_MAX_ATTEMPTS` 3, hedge after 45 s, route timeout 180 s |
| Tool Service | HTTP via `tool_resolver` (httpx) | Synthesis, execution, registry, MCP | none | Client timeout 180 s; connect failures retried with backoff from 1 s to 10 s for `TOOL_SERVICE_WAIT_SECONDS` (90); 502–504 retried for reads only; jobs awaited up to 1200 s |
| Neo4j | Bolt driver (`neo4j`) | Graph store and queries | Neo4j 5 | Transaction timeout 60 s (server) |
| Remote hosts | paramiko SSH, the Brev CLI (`BREV_CLI`, WSL on Windows), cloud SDK/REST | Deploy, run commands, diagnostics | none | Commands up to 3600 s; bootstrap 900 s; the worker wait polls every 5 s for 180 s |
| MCP servers | JSON-RPC over HTTP (Tool Service) | External tools | none | Per server |
